decisions.decision: Sharing is a planner decision; refcount on the wire subscription
decisions.rationale: GOALS:296 forbids erasing distinctions on filter equality; a merged filter equals none of its inputs

decisions.decision: Grouping batches unsent demand only; a sent subscription is never rewritten
decisions.rationale: nmp measured the alternative at 90% waste and 1-to-20 subscriptions at twenty growth steps

decisions.decision: Routers get a one-method trait refusing non-Explicit/non-CacheOnly, running the exact same code path
decisions.rationale: the concrete Fava would confer publish/close/reset, create an Arc cycle, and tie routers to one engine

decisions.decision: WRITE-027: a healthy chain answering absence settles terminal; a failed router must not
decisions.rationale: GOALS:1003 conditions the stay-open clause on unresolved, not empty
a summary from what shipped describes the code instead of testing it; that is the M2-M4 artifact 07.9 revokes

decisions.decision: Delete ObserveError::Relay rather than reshape it
decisions.rationale: GOALS:325 permits only local-source failure and shutdown as open failures
